feedback: The confession follows the pre-vote contradiction directly: Vincent admits the real bottle was on display and that the model story was designed to erase the source. The preview access and later unattended glass visit already supplied a coherent route, so his account feels earned. Taking poison during the preview and putting it in the glass are newly explicit admissions, but they confirm the inferred act rather than introduce an unavailable decisive clue. His final emotional turn connects artistic humiliation and jealousy to a choice he now owns, without excusing it. Hugh and Chip retain meaningful wrongdoing and regret instead of becoming entirely innocent decorations. The ending is concise and emotionally satisfying, although Vincent's exact concealment and transfer procedure remain understated.
